records.description: Connect Claude, ChatGPT or any AI you already use and let it track your life for you: gym, diet, sleep, work, money, notes and todos. Giving you time to do the actual work that matters.

records.name: Ubwiru Email Agent
records.tagline: 9 AI employees for your business. Zero cloud. Zero leaks.
records.description: Ubwiru Email Agent reads your inbox, classifies every message, and drafts professional replies for you to review — running entirely on your own computer. (Beta v0.1)

records.name: Vehicle Cyber ForenX Tool
records.tagline: Evidence in Report out
records.description: A guided forensic investigation tool for cyber incidents and vehicle telematics fraud, from raw evidence to a client ready report.

records.name: PolicyMesh — Govern. Enforce. Trust.
records.tagline: Data governance for secure cross-border data flows
records.description: PolicyMesh helps teams prevent non-compliant data movement across services and regions. Define policies in YAML, classify sensitive data with AI, check commits through GitHub Actions, enforce ALLOW/DENY decisions at runtime, and maintain tamper-evident audit lineage. Built for security, DevOps, and compliance teams.

records.name: SlumberWave
records.tagline: Mix your own sleep sound. Free forever, no ads.
records.description: Unwind with SlumberWave with ad-free download now. Research-inspired soundscapes including rain, ocean waves, white noise, and womb sounds, designed for restful sleep, focus, and calm. Free on iOS & Android.

records.name: Lumen
records.tagline: medicine, made legible
records.description: Clinical information is written for clinicians. Lumen translates it for the person holding it. Photograph your medicine boxes to see what each is for and which combinations to ask a pharmacist about—quoted word for word from the official FDA label. Paste your lab results for every value in plain language, including how many were normal. Describe a symptom for how urgently to seek care and where to go. Clinical facts never come from the model. It doesn't diagnose you and stores nothing.

records.name: Floki
records.tagline: Plan trips without spreadsheets
records.description: Floki turns booking confirmations into an organized trip. Forward your emails, let AI fill your free days with plans tuned to how you travel, and bring friends and family along.

records.name: Veyra Careers
records.tagline: Fix your resume. Find better-fit jobs. Get ready to apply.
records.description: Veyra Careers helps international job seekers improve their real experience, optimize resumes for ATS and different countries, and find better-fit opportunities. Upload your CV, get a personalized analysis, fix what’s holding you back, and move from resume to application with confidence. No fabricated experience — just smarter career preparation.

records.name: Smart Thumbnail AI Agent
records.tagline: Let AI agents choose the perfect thumbnail from your videos!
records.description: A good thumbnail is the biggest reason people click. With Smart Thumbnails, you can ask your AI assistant to get you the best thumbnail from any video that is statistically most likely to drive clicks and engagement. The thumbnail is literally the only part of your video that every potential viewer sees. A blurry, mid-blink, half-dark frame buries great content. That's why we launched Smart Thumbnails to automatically choose the perfect thumbnail from your videos to boost engagement!

records.name: CritiqueLab
records.tagline: A Duolingo/Chess.com for Debate
records.description: CritiqueLab is an all-in-one AI debate platform that lets students debate AI, practice arguments, and receive detailed reasoning analysis in one place. Students can challenge different perspectives, identify logical fallacies and weak reasoning, generate counterarguments, and get feedback on their performance. Unlike traditional debate resources, CritiqueLab gives students an always-available practice partner, helping them consistently improve their debating and critical thinking skills.

records.name: Alve
records.tagline: The ad-free, frictionless breathwork app.
records.description: Alve translates clinical breathing ratios into 60fps parametric geometry and synthesized audio. No paywalls, no ads, no logins. Built for knowledge workers who need a 2-minute nervous system reset without the bloat of traditional meditation apps.

records.name: StepNext - Your next step, made clear
records.tagline: Compare paths. See risks. Choose your next step
records.description: StepNext is a decision-support platform that helps users explore different career and life paths before making important choices. Instead of simply giving advice, StepNext uses the user’s current profile, goals, skills, commitments, and constraints to compare possible scenarios, highlight risks and trade-offs, and show potential consequences. Its Digital Twin, risk analysis, and Future Simulator work together to turn uncertainty into clearer, more informed next steps.

records.name: Silsilah
records.tagline: Private, offline-first family tree app, on-device face match
records.description: Silsilah: Family Tree is a private family-tree app for your phone. Build your tree, add photos, and keep everything on your device — no account, no cloud, no tracking. Try the builder right in your browser.

records.name: SpaceShare
records.tagline: Spaces to share. Places to work. People to meet.
records.description: Remote work gave us flexibility, but it also gave us empty apartments and Slack messages that never quite replace human company. SpaceShare isn't just cheaper coworking, it's someone making coffee in the kitchen while you both work. We built the trust layer (verified hosts, gradual address reveal, women-only spaces) so opening your home doesn't feel risky. Think Airbnb, but the amenity is company, not the couch.

records.name: BeenuLabs
records.tagline: Reply to every app review, in every language, in minutes.
records.description: BeenuLabs reads every review on the App Store and Google Play and drafts a reply in your brand voice — in the language the reviewer used, with an English translation so you can approve one you cannot read. Nothing is published without you unless you switch auto-publish on yourself, and even then only for reviews that clear rules you set. Negative reviews are emailed to you the moment they land. Free for 10 replies a month, no card.

records.name: ChinaLLM Free AI Tools
records.tagline: Plan AI image, video, and ecommerce work for free.
records.description: Three browser-based tools to estimate AI image and video generation costs, structure safer ecommerce product-image prompts, and calculate image sizes and aspect ratios. No login, uploads, API keys, or paid generation required.

records.name: Puking Cat The Game
records.tagline: Your cat has one job: ruin the room.
records.description: Puking Cat is a mobile game about making the biggest mess possible. Puke on furniture, food, plants and anything else in reach, earn Puke Coins, unlock costumes and puke palettes, and come back for new seasonal levels. All levels are free with ads.

records.name: LinkApp
records.tagline: Social media link in bio links app
records.description: The number of searches for this type of service is increasing, and it can provide the same service as competitors.

records.name: BaseParse
records.tagline: Document Intelligence AI
records.description: BaseParse is the ultimate Document Intelligence API for AI engineers. Its highlight? Flawlessly parsing complex research papers, exam papers, medical reports, and scanned documents into clean, structured JSON. Unlike basic OCR tools, BaseParse retains 100% of document context—preserving multi-column text, complex tables, mathematical formulas, diagrams, and reading order. Seamlessly feed high-precision data into your LLMs, RAG pipelines, and AI agents with zero information loss.

records.name: Keep Above
records.tagline: Budgeting that looks forward — no spending history
records.description: Keep Above works out the balance that covers every upcoming bill, so you can see what's genuinely spare. Enter your bills once, keep one number current — no spending history, it only looks forward. Free calculators on the site: no sign-up, nothing saved.

records.name: Semper Fi Home Inspection
records.tagline: Inspect anywhere, sync later, deliver the PDF on site
records.description: Built by a working home inspector, not a software company. Most inspection apps assume you have signal — crawlspaces, attics, and rural properties don't. Semper Fi captures rooms, findings, and photos fully offline, syncs when you're back in range, and generates a client-ready PDF with a clickable table of contents. Photos save straight to your phone gallery. $38.99/month against competitors at $69–$109, plus a 14-day free trial.

records.name: Plexavo
records.tagline: Find AWS security holes before they find you
records.description: Scans your AWS account for misconfigurations and privilege escalation paths, then hands back a plain-English report (HTML/PDF) with the exact fix not a wall of unreadable JSON. Runs on your own local credentials, zero telemetry. Open source. A streamlined AWS security scanner designed for effortless setup and execution. No need to memorize commands or flags !! Cloud Security Simplified.

records.name: Conifer SDK
records.tagline: One gateway for every model, with per-call cost receipts.
records.description: Conifer is an open-source SDK that routes cloud, local, and BYOK inference through one gateway. Every call returns an exact cost receipt, including cache reads and writes, so you know what each request actually cost instead of guessing from a monthly bill. It works with hosted APIs, self-hosted models, and local models on your own machine. It is free when you bring your own keys, there is no forced rerouting, and it ships in TypeScript and Python.

records.name: Proofly: AI Career Readiness Platform
records.tagline: Proofly — Don't Just Apply. Know Your Match.
records.description: Prove your career readiness with verifiable evidence, explainable skill mapping, and Career Trials. Proofly turns your resumes, certificates, projects, internships, and GitHub work into an evidence-backed skill map, then matches it against real job opportunities to reveal your strengths, gaps, and next steps.

records.name: KnowledgeNav
records.tagline: Turn intent into outcome.
records.description: Most AI tools give you a wall of text. KnowledgeNav gives you a real interactive plan: sliders, comparison tables, budgets, checklists, calendars, and charts that recalculate live as you adjust constraints. Grounded in reality with live web results, real calculations, weather, local places, and your own documents. Runs on two AI providers with automatic fallback. Optional memory remembers context across visits, fully under your control. Free: 3 plans/month. Pro: $8/mo.

records.name: MapToWeb
records.tagline: Build full website on 5 second
records.description: Tempel link Google Maps bisnismu, dapatkan landing page profesional lengkap dengan AI copywriting, tombol WhatsApp order, ulasan bintang 5, dan optimasi SEO dalam hitungan detik. Siap untuk iklan Meta & Google Ads.

records.name: Flipeet Health
records.tagline: Everyday habits for a healthier tomorrow
records.description: Flipeet Health is an everyday health companion that brings practical health information, personalised reminders, challenges, family health tracking and health education into one place. We’re especially interested in making preventive health feel less complicated and more relevant to everyday life in Africa. This is still an early MVP, and we’re sharing it because we want to learn what’s genuinely useful, what feels unnecessary, what’s missing, and how we can make it even better.

records.name: Tidbit
records.tagline: Make scrolling worth remembering.
records.description: A feed that grows with your attention span. Tidbit is a personalized AI knowledge feed that transforms the way you consume content. Instead of chasing engagement, it delivers bite-sized ideas in the topics you genuinely care about: AI, psychology, finance, history, design, and more. Read, listen, save, and go deeper. As your curiosity and retention grow, Tidbit’s Adaptive Depth makes every card more insightful, creating a feed that evolves with you.

records.name: JustA11y
records.tagline: Accessibility, made easier
records.description: JustA11y makes digital accessibility easier to understand for beginners. Learn through short, visual lessons, real-world examples, interactive questions, and scenario-based practice instead of dense technical jargon. Explore topics from accessibility fundamentals, to everyday digital barriers then turn what you learn into practical habits.

records.name: Indexly
records.tagline: Get organic traffic for your B2B SaaS
records.description: Indexly is an AI SEO agent that finds the keywords your competitors rank for, scores every opportunity, and writes and auto-publishes SEO-optimized articles to your blog so you get discovered on Google, ChatGPT, and Perplexity on autopilot.

records.name: Builder Network
records.tagline: Find the people building around you
records.description: Builder Network is a networking layer for hackathons, meetups, conferences, and tech events. Instead of hoping to meet the right people, discover builders around you based on skills, interests, and what they're building. Join an event, find teammates and collaborators nearby, connect instantly, and keep the conversation going after the event. Built to turn crowded tech events into meaningful connections.

records.name: AsyncFlow — Zero Meetings. Forever.
records.tagline: AI workspace that kills all meetings. Forever.
records.description: AsyncFlow eliminates all meetings for remote teams — forever. Submit async voice or text updates, get Gemini AI summaries automatically, and replace video interviews with a 5-round async hiring system. Every decision is timestamped in a legal audit trail. No standups. No syncs. No video interviews. Built for teams that work on their own terms.

records.name: Ultimate AI Interviewer
records.tagline: Turn Interview Preperation into career readiness
records.description: The ultimate AI interviewer is an app built to make interview prep less overwhelming and more strategic for recent graduates. ​The app has key features such as uploading the resume, getting personalized career guidance, and voice-based practice with adaptive questions. ​The user gets feedback and STAR refinement, all in one place. ​Instead of getting generic practice, students get tailored interview guidance for corporate roles, civil services, competitive exams, and other career paths.

records.name: Everloggers
records.tagline: The ultimate social market for buying and selling friends
records.description: Everloggers turns your friends into a live, tradable social economy. Unlike traditional social networks where profiles are static and likes/followers are the currency, Everloggers gives every person a value that changes as they’re bought and traded. Friends can buy each other, watch their value rise, compete on leaderboards, and turn the whole thing into a running joke with their group. What makes it stand out: • A living people market • Shareable moments • Built for groups

records.name: Ekata: Global scholarships for you
records.tagline: Global education funding, matched to you
records.description: Ekata is the all-in-one platform for global students. Key features include: - Scholarship Matcher: AI-powered grants matched to you. - AI Docs Builder: Instantly generate SOPs, LORs, and resumes. - Financial Aid Calculator: Compute tuition, living costs, and net funding. - Community & Resources: Connect with peers and access expert guides. Sign up and fund your future today!

records.name: 50 AI Copywriting Prompts Bundle
records.tagline: Generate copy 10x faster with 50 AI prompts
records.description: Get 50 AI copywriting prompts for ChatGPT and Claude. Generate professional copy in minutes. **Included:** ✅ Sales Pages (15 prompts) ✅ Email Sequences (15 prompts) ✅ Social Media & Ads (15 prompts) ✅ Bonus Business (5 prompts) **How It Works:** Copy → Paste → Customize → Generate **Perfect For:** Freelancers, marketers, entrepreneurs, content creators Save 5-10 hours per week on copywriting. Instant PDF • Lifetime access • $29

records.name: SUON
records.tagline: Unclench. Unwind. Grow gently.
records.description: SUON is an AI powered emotional space built on a simple premise:calming your body is the essential first step before understanding words. • Zero friction: An anonymous name, 0 login, 0 streak pressure, 100% private. • Body first approach: Ground your physical body before unpacking heavy feelings. • Gentle AI reflection: Chat with SUON, take tiny micro actions and grow your valley of calm. We don't ask users to maintain strict streaks, daily check lists or to-dos. We make feeling better simple.

records.name: Pip's World
records.tagline: A bedtime story where your child is the main character
records.description: A tiny dragon called Pip comes to the window, and your child becomes the main character — by name, age, and the things they love. Every night continues the same saga, read aloud in each character's own voice. First story free, no card. Ages 3–9.

records.name: Northern Lights Tonight
records.tagline: GO, MAYBE, or NO—tonight's aurora call for your exact place
records.description: Check northern lights tonight for US cities and states. Local GO, MAYBE, or NO from NOAA and clouds, not one national Kp number.

records.name: SafeHer
records.tagline: AI-driven, offline-first personal safety guardian for women
records.description: SafeHer is an offline-first personal safety companion designed specifically for women. Unlike other safety apps that fail in poor network conditions, SafeHer operates entirely offline using local SQLite data structures and device telemetry. Key features: • AI-powered Fake Escort Call with vocal Safe-Word triggers. • Automated background audio and photo evidence capture. • Seamless SQLite-to-Firebase sync. • Real-time tracking link for contacts. • Gemini AI-powered FIR draft generator.

records.name: PlateGuard AI
records.tagline: Scan any food or medicine label against your health profile
records.description: Scan any food or medicine label - camera, barcode, or pasted text - and get a verdict checked against YOUR allergies, conditions & meds, not a generic score. You get a 1-5 rating plus the exact ingredient responsible. What's different: - Weighs your full profile together, not one field at a time - Medicine mode flags drug interactions - A profile per family member + a printable emergency card - Multi-AI failover so no single provider blocks a scan.

records.name: Sequence Social
records.tagline: Your whole social content workflow in one place
records.description: Sequence is a shared social content workspace for agencies, content teams, and clients. Plan content, review media, collect approvals, publish, manage comments and DMs, compare organic and paid performance, and create with AI without stitching together a different tool for every step. Free includes one brand and the complete workflow; Pro scales by brand, not by seat.

records.name: Pasteup — Collage Art Studio
records.tagline: Collage art using own images or public-domain - public beta
records.description: Pasteup is a browser-based collage studio — free during public beta. Search millions of openly-licensed images from NYPL, Smithsonian, and Europeana, or upload your own photos and scans. Crop, lasso, cut with an X-Acto knife that splits an image in two, tape, filter, and layer — plus a cassette J-card canvas format for mixtape nostalgia. Save your work and publish a shareable link when ready. No stock fees, no subscription.

records.name: Echo Room
records.tagline: Not another feed. A real person, when you need one.
records.description: A private Echo Room is a calm, private space to put down what's echoing in your mind, then get matched with another real person for an honest conversation. No feeds, no likes, no performance. Write an Echo when something's sitting heavy, and when you're ready, talk it through with someone who gets it. Built with safety as a first-class feature, not an afterthought: reporting, blocking, and AI-assisted screening keep the space trustworthy from day one.

records.name: Social Publisher Bridge 2 Buffer
records.tagline: Auto-publish WordPress to Buffer free (3 socials, $0/mo)
records.description: Connect WordPress directly to Buffer.com’s Free plan (3 social channels at $0/mo) via official GraphQL API. Auto-publish posts, pages & WooCommerce products across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and X with zero middleman servers. Includes simultaneous multi-channel sharing, 6-tier image fallback, TinyURL shortener, live previews, and Pro WooCommerce carousels + local GDPR analytics. Say goodbye to manual copy-pasting!

records.name: Tiny Concepts
records.tagline: Bring your questions to life.
records.description: Young minds are full of questions. Tiny Concepts lets them follow their curiosity and watch their questions come alive. They can ask Tiny anything and receive a beautiful animated explanation. The visual style, detail, and vocabulary adapt to their age, helping big ideas feel approachable. We work carefully to keep explanations clear and accurate, and check every question and concept for safety. No streaks or tricks to keep them hooked. Just the joy of wondering and discovering something new.

records.name: Motion Hero: Scroll Video for Shopify
records.tagline: Make shoppers say wow with video that moves as they scroll
records.description: Motion Hero turns one product video into a scroll-controlled experience. In Frame-by-Frame mode, the video stays in place while shoppers scroll to reveal every moment—ideal for product reveals, launches, and premium visual stories. Choose from 3 modes: Frame-by-Frame Scroll, Guided Play/Pause, or Standard Video. Add timed text, images, buttons, icons, and shapes, customize desktop and mobile layouts, preview the result, and publish it to any page.

records.name: AI Pitch Coach
records.tagline: Your idea deserves a better pitch🚀
records.description: AI Pitch Coach AI Pitch Coach is a voice-first AI mentor that helps founders turn ideas into powerful pitches. It provides instant feedback, evaluates strengths and risks, asks investor-style follow-up questions, and transforms ideas into compelling 30-second and 60-second pitches. With interactive voice-based rehearsal, founders can practice, refine, and build confidence before facing real investors, judges, or customers. 🚀

records.name: NoiseTimer Android App
records.tagline: White, pink & brown noise for sleep, focus and relaxation.
records.description: NoiseTimer is a lightweight Android app built around one simple idea: play the noise you need without distractions. Choose between white, pink, and brown noise and keep it playing in the background while you sleep, relax, or focus. What makes NoiseTimer different is what it leaves out: no ads, no accounts, no tracking, and no unnecessary features. It’s small, fast, and designed to get from opening the app to playing sound in just a couple of taps.

records.name: Oppniva — Find your next opportunity
records.tagline: Discover. Connect. Grow.
records.description: Personalized competitions, workshops, volunteering, communities, and career pathways for ambitious students.

records.name: MicroClash
records.tagline: 60 tiny games, 10 friends, one champion
records.description: MicroClash is a party arcade of 60 micro-games - each lasts 5-10 seconds and needs one finger. Up to 10 friends play live rooms where everyone gets the same game with the same random seed at the same moment, so only skill decides the podium. One-tap link invites, no accounts. Plus a global daily challenge with streaks, solo runs, endless mode and practice. Free on Android, built by one person, with a new game shipping every week or two.

records.name: SigmaPointPi
records.tagline: One financial system for startups and operators
records.description: Ledger, invoices, bills, receipts, payroll, tax, banking, forecasting, cap table. Payroll produces real W-2 and 941. Sales tax reconciles against your bank deposits. Sigma is an agent you talk to that reads your books. For startups and multi-business operators.

records.name: GodCalm
records.tagline: Daily Bible, prayer journal & calm audio sanctuary
records.description: GodCalm is a free web app for daily Bible reading, guided devotionals, and prayer journaling. Read the full Bible (KJV/WEB, Reina-Valera), follow 17 guided plans on Faith, Discipline & Purpose, keep a private prayer journal, and unwind in a Sound Sanctuary of ambient audio (rain, forest, river, night breeze). Track streaks and build a daily habit of peace. No app store needed — works instantly in your browser, in English and Spanish. Free to start, with an optional Pro plan (7-day trial).

records.name: BidmySpot
records.tagline: bid-to-rank board for iOS, Android, Web apps
records.description: iOS apps, Android apps, X profile and web products bid to stay on top. Rank is the bid — outbid alternative for mobile apps.

records.name: AuraCheck
records.tagline: From Vibe to Verified
records.description: We built a platform, a live voice-to-voice interview and presentation prep platform designed specifically for fresher graduates. The user is evaluated by a live panel of 5 specialized AI agents that dynamically interact with each other. The system doesn't just listen it cross-references the user's spoken answers against their real GitHub code, portfolio websites, and resumes to fact-check their actual skills, all while giving instant feedback on their English, delivery, and domain knowledge.

records.name: Asterful – Explore the Universe
records.tagline: You are made of stars
records.description: Have you ever felt like you didn’t belong somewhere? Like you had something to say, but couldn’t find the right people to say it to? Asterful is a space to discover people, ideas, and conversations around the things you genuinely care about. Because sometimes, finding your people starts with finding what connects you.

records.name: TestForce Teacher
records.tagline: Everything you need to transform education.
records.description: TestForce gives educators one place to run their entire classroom. Create AI-powered tests in seconds, import question banks, automate grading, use AI proctoring, generate branded PDF tests, share lectures and notes, and track student performance with detailed analytics. Virtual classrooms keep everything organized for students, replacing scattered WhatsApp groups and multiple tools with one streamlined workflow.

records.name: BizWise - Your Business Partner
records.tagline: Find Where Your Money Goes.
records.description: BizWise is an AI-powered B2B SaaS platform for profit intelligence. It analyzes fragmented business data across sales, inventory, advertising, pricing, returns, and expenses to uncover hidden profit leaks and missed opportunities. From identifying capital trapped in dead inventory to pinpointing unprofitable ad spend, BizWise quantifies financial impact and prioritizes the actions that can improve profitability—turning raw business data into measurable financial outcomes.

records.name: Laetus
records.tagline: The science of personal luck
records.description: Laetus is a behavioral analytics platform exploring how people make decisions under uncertainty. It combines probability, personal observations, lottery experiments, blockchain randomness, and AI-assisted analytics into one research framework. Instead of encouraging gambling, Laetus helps users study decision patterns, compare behavioral signals, and better understand their own responses to uncertainty through long-term observation.

records.name: Estimaty
records.tagline: AI-powered estimates for design projects in minutes
records.description: Estimaty turns a plain-language project description into a clear, professional design estimate in minutes. No spreadsheets, no back-and-forth, no guesswork. Just describe your idea and get a fast, realistic breakdown you can send to clients or use to scope work internally. Built for designers, studios, and agencies who spend too much time estimating UI/UX projects manually. What makes it different: it's AI-native, instant, and produces estimates you can actually defend.

records.name: HFX
records.tagline: Your brand's distribution engine: built, owned, automated.
records.description: Most agencies rent you attention. HFX builds you the machine. We create an owned network of pages around your brand, fuel it with AI-generated content at scale and access to 1M+ creators, then wire in ManyChat automation that turns reach into revenue. Thousands of content pieces, guaranteed distribution, and a conversion pipeline, all assets you own outright. Not a campaign. Infrastructure.

records.name: publicdesktop.lol
records.tagline: Public computer of the internet
records.description: Buy a permanent $10 icon location on the internet's public computer, or bid to control its public song.

records.name: Democruit
records.tagline: Your candidate-first career companion, from resume to offer
records.description: Democruit takes you from resume to offer with AI-powered guidance at every step. Unlike single-prompt tools, it helps you understand how to improve every application, not just generate one. Get ATS analysis, tailored cover letters, application tracking, and a personal resume website. Designed to help you land interviews, not just create documents. No subscriptions, pay 50% now and the rest only if you get hired within 12 months (no proof required). Recently laid off? Message us for free access.

records.name: AquaRise App
records.tagline: Take action. Restore our waters.
records.description: AquaRise is an environmental platform designed to make taking action for our waters easier. The idea is simple: discover polluted beaches, rivers, lakes, and other waterbodies, learn why they need attention, and connect with real cleanup opportunities already organized by environmental groups.

records.name: NaviTry
records.tagline: Don't choose your future. Navigate it.
records.description: Most people don’t choose a career because they truly know 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐰𝐚𝐧𝐭. They choose from 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰, 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲’𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐨𝐥𝐝, or 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐡𝐚𝐩𝐩𝐞𝐧 to discover first. NaviTry helps you explore multiple career paths based on who you are, understand what each path involves, and experience what it could actually feel like. Because your first career idea shouldn’t become your final destination. Try Before You Choose. Navigate Before You Commit.

records.name: Brain Byte
records.tagline: Turn anything you study into a learning journey.
records.description: BrainByte turns anything you study —PDFs, notes, and videos — into a learning journey: concepts, challenges, and targeted review, engineered for retention. Students spend less time searching, passively watching, and rewatching, and more time understanding, practicing, and revising Badges

records.name: ROAMIE
records.tagline: Plan smarter. Spend better. Pack effortlessly.
records.description: Roamie is your AI-powered travel companion that makes trip planning simple and personalized. Create day-by-day itineraries based on your destination, budget, travel dates, and preferences. Track your expenses, check destination weather, and stay on top of your trip—all in one place. Roamie also helps you decide what to wear. Upload your clothes to create a virtual wardrobe, and get AI-powered outfit suggestions based on the weather, destination, and activities.

records.name: I AM
records.tagline: Creating spaces for you to be.
records.description: I AM is your sanctuary to slow down, reconnect with yourself, and discover who you are beyond what you do. Built on the belief that being comes before doing, I AM brings reflection, journaling, personal experiments, and the Identity Compass together to cultivate self-knowledge. Instead of telling you who to become, I AM helps you discover who you are.

records.name: Mugiwara Security
records.tagline: Proves vulnerabilities before reporting them.
records.description: Most scanners flag anything suspicious and leave you to sort out what's real. Mugiwara proves it instead. It generates a proof-of-concept exploit, runs it in an isolated container, and only marks a finding verified if the attack actually works. For verified issues, an AI patches a disposable copy and we re-run the same exploit to confirm it's blocked. Everything runs locally-your code never leaves your machine. V0: injection classes in Python. Feedback welcome, especially on false positives.

records.name: MINTI
records.tagline: Author your ideas. Interrogate every premise
records.description: MINTI is an AI writing copilot that helps you think before it helps you write. Instead of immediately rewriting your work, MINTI uses Socratic questioning to help you clarify ideas, challenge assumptions, identify gaps in your arguments, and strengthen your reasoning. When you're ready, it supports grammar, language, clarity, and structure without replacing your voice or taking ownership of your ideas. Because better writing starts with better thinking.

records.name: AgroShield
records.tagline: Crypto-powered crop insurance for african smallholders
records.description: AgroShield is a decentralized parametric crop insurance platform on the Stellar blockchain that gives smallholder farmers fast, affordable protection against drought. records.tagline: Catch a wrong drawing revision before it's cut
records.description: Drawrev is being built to watch the inbox where OEM drawings arrive and flag a revision mismatch before the print reaches the shop floor. Not live yet: leave your email to hear the moment it opens.

records.name: Mixio
records.tagline: macOS volume mixer, per app & tab, EQ with native style UI
records.description: macOS volume mixer, per app & tab & 10-bands EQ with native style UI - RadixIV/Mixio

records.name: cAn·did
records.tagline: Screen it before you post it..!
records.description: cAn·did shifts the wedge from “AI that creates content” → “AI that closes the loop once you post!” It runs critics across voice, hook, visual design, audience fit, and performance. They can disagree. A lead critic turns that into a candid verdict, score, and one fix. The interesting part? It gets smarter after you post. Log what happened, feed back the outcome, and your next screening is based on more evidence about you.

records.name: MELD
records.tagline: Don't ask around, post it and gather your crew.
records.description: MELD — Got something you want to do, but nobody to do it with? Post it on MELD. MELD helps you find people for the things you want to do. Have an idea? A project? A plan? Post it on MELD and let people who are interested discover it and join your crew. No more asking around or wondering "who’s interested" Just post it, find your people, and get started. We’re live and still figuring things out. Try it, explore it, and tell us what you’d change.

records.name: ShiftGuard Premium
records.tagline: A workforce-operations foundation for healthcare teams
records.description: ShiftGuard Premium is a pre-revenue workforce-operations foundation built with React, Vite and Supabase. It brings employee and shift management, configurable operational checks, reporting and PDF export, audit-oriented workflows and PWA support into one responsive workspace. Built initially for healthcare teams, it can be adapted to other workforce-heavy industries. We’re launching to gather honest feedback and explore a €1,500 one-time software-asset acquisition. Buyer due diligence is welcome

records.name: TaleReady
records.tagline: Your own audiobooks, verified offline on Apple Watch
records.description: Import DRM-free MP3, M4A, and M4B audiobooks on iPhone, choose a listening window or full book, and TaleReady only marks it ready after Apple Watch has stored and verified playable audio. Listen from the Watch without the iPhone nearby. No account, ads, tracking, or subscription. Core listening is free; an optional one-time $7.99 purchase adds larger offline windows and automation.

records.name: Prompter
records.tagline: Never lose your place while reading a script
records.description: Prompter is a focused teleprompter for iPhone and iPad that helps you look at the audience or camera and return without losing your place. Search scripts by title or text, let Read Tracking fade completed lines, and set a target time for a natural scroll pace. Mirror Mode supports beam-splitter rigs, while iCloud and Home Screen widgets keep every draft close. Pay once. No subscription.

records.name: GoBeyond Formation
records.tagline: Go Beyond Your Imagination!
records.description: Global Business Infrastructure

records.name: Veraia
records.tagline: Digital AI Health Assistant
records.description: Veraia is a personal AI health assistant for individuals, carers, and families in the UK, Malta and Bulgaria. We help people hold their health story — every result, every prescription, every appointment — in one place, so they can walk into any conversation with their doctor prepared and in control. Over time, our AI starts to notice patterns in your data and surfaces useful Observations. We are not a medical device. We are not a diagnosis. We are the memory layer that healthcare never had.

records.name: Safe Signals app
records.tagline: Personal safety, faster — one‑tap alerts. Emergency alerts
records.description: Safe Signals is a personal safety app that helps you get help faster. Trigger one‑tap alerts, share your live location, send discreet signals, and guide your contacts with clear emergency steps. It works on Android, iPhone, and Web. Join the waitlist to get early access and help shape the beta.

records.name: TurnAudit
records.tagline: Turnover documentation for short-term rentals
records.description: TurnAudit helps short-term rental hosts and operators document property condition before and after turnovers. Capture timestamped walkthrough records, preserve sealed originals, organize findings by room, and export a verifiable record that supports damage claims and quality control. Advisory AI can surface possible issues for human review. TurnAudit is live. The free trial includes one turnover, no credit card, and one advisory baseline AI review.

records.name: Resonant Worlds Explorer
records.tagline: Exact-math AI for Nasa exoplanet & biosignatures.
records.description: ​Resonant Worlds Explorer processes light curves and spectra from NASA missions (JWST, TESS, Kepler) to detect exoplanets and analyze atmospheric biosignatures. Built with Modulus—our custom AI solver extending Qwen with a Prime Algebra Transformer—the system converts astrophysics and chemical equilibrium equations into exact arithmetic. This eliminates floating-point errors, dramatically reducing false positives in the search for life. Includes live web plots and PDF reports.

records.name: QuantumRho
records.tagline: 128+ Turnkey AI Micro-Services & 26 Free Developer Tools
records.description: QuantumRho is an institutional AI engineering catalog featuring 128+ turnkey micro-services (FinTech OCR, Computer Vision, Voice AI, Web & Cloud) and 26 free interactive developer tools with 100% IP ownership and 5–7 day fast-launch SLAs.

records.name: thematicanalysis.ai
records.tagline: AI-powered thematic analysis for qualitative research
records.description: thematicanalysis.ai is an easy to use AI tool that helps students and researchers analyse to autocode and generate themes from thier qualitative data. You can upload interviews, transcripts or research papers, the engine then generate codes and themes, which are traceable to thier sources. You can then export the result and the codebook.

records.name: UsageAtlas
records.tagline: Track your AI coding usage, trends, insights in one place.
records.description: Local-first AI usage tracker for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenCode. Tokens, costs, limits, and reset times in one dashboard that stays on your machine. Open-source desktop app to easily understand all your AI coding usage tracking, trends, insights, analytics, tokens, cost, remaining limits, reset times etc.. across different AI Coding Tools, in one simple app. Stays on your machine. No account.

records.name: NodeXLoop — Agent Loop DevTools
records.tagline: Debug AI agents like you debug code
records.description: A visual debugger for AI agent loops, inside VS Code. Build Agent → tool → critic → retry → gate → test → approve on a canvas, run it node-by-node with breakpoints, and see exactly which call the guard blocked and why. The graph is aloop.yaml next to your code, so it reviews in the same PR. Axiom guard on by default: a stalled critic loop drops from 20 model calls to 6, a prompt injection costs 0. 37 templates, org review (local preview), audit export. Free on the Marketplace and Open VSX

records.name: Deploy, showcase, and monetize web apps
records.tagline: The easiest place to build deploy and earn.
records.description: Solvante is the easiest place to deploy on. Anyone can build and deploy for themselves, connect their version control for automated updates, or launch and earn with others on our active marketplace. It provides all the tools you need to go from code to a live application instantly. You can easily manage your builds, track performance, and share your creations with a global audience.

records.name: EvokeStory
records.tagline: AI screenwriting and production management in one place
records.description: EvokeStory is an AI-native workspace for screenwriters and producers. Write in industry-standard screenplay format, then let EVO analyse structure, character arcs, tone and pacing scene by scene. Multi-model routing sends each creative task to the AI that actually performs best on it, instead of betting everything on one LLM. From first draft to storyboards, breakdowns, pitch decks and budgets, the whole production pipeline lives in one place. Built by filmmakers, for filmmakers.

records.name: RedMirror: make any LLM find real bugs
records.tagline: Make any LLM find real bugs in your code, and prove them
records.description: Give any model the power to find real bugs and prove them: it guides your agent to where bugs live, then a compiled kernel searches every reachable state and returns a replayable attack path, or a proof it's safe. New: it now also finds injection bugs and lands the exploit on a live app. On the 440-case OpenSSF benchmark a 20b model matches the 120b at 96%. Runs offline, your model. Free 7-day trial, then $4.99/mo.

records.name: Online HTML Editor
records.tagline: makes it easier to edit and modify HTML files
records.description: Online HTML editor for importing or pasting complete HTML source, editing text, structure and CSS styles, previewing and running HTML, undoing changes, saving locally and downloading files.

records.name: BaryGraph — coordinate system for models
records.tagline: A graph-and-vector architecture for exploratory retrieval
records.description: A graph-and-vector architecture for exploratory retrieval connecting otherwise distant regions of a semantic space. When a model searches for what is close to a query, it often finds familiar associations, and examples of the same idea. That is useful for lookup, but limited for exploration. Exploration needs coordinate system that can locate relations, tensions, contradictions. BaryGraph makes those relationships retrievable. A result may be a bridge, a contradiction, a higher-order pattern.

records.name: AI Automation Offer Builder
records.tagline: Turn one business problem into a safe AI service offer
records.description: Choose a buyer, repeated workflow, reviewable output, and human approval point. Get a clear service sentence, five discovery questions, a fake-data demo checklist, and a reusable prompt for your preferred AI agent. Free, no signup, and nothing is stored.

records.name: RealFix A11y
records.tagline: AI-powered accessibility testing and fixes
records.description: RealFix A11y goes beyond simply detecting accessibility issues—it helps developers understand and fix them. It uses AI to identify WCAG accessibility problems, explain why they matter, and suggest practical fixes. With automated scanning, clear issue reports, and actionable recommendations, RealFix A11y makes web accessibility faster, simpler, and more developer-friendly.

records.name: LemonApp
records.tagline: Free AI image & video generator powered by rewarded tasks
records.description: LemonApp makes generative AI accessible to everyone with zero subscriptions or upfront fees. Create high-resolution AI images, cinematic videos, and scripts powered by FLUX, SDXL, and Kling. Earn free generation credits anytime by completing quick rewarded tasks and offers. Instant generation, full aspect ratio controls, and no credit card required.

records.name: genvi
records.tagline: One canvas for everything you generate
records.description: genvi is one canvas for AI image, video, music, voice and 3D. Describe what you want in chat, or wire models into a node graph you can re-run. Cut it on a real timeline and export MP4 in the browser. 40+ models, one credit balance, one file repository.

records.name: Quanttools.io
records.tagline: Calculate Power Analysis, portfolio risk, stock correlations
records.description: Quanttools offers free (and paid) tools for statisticians, data analysts, and quants. - Run power analysis for different types of 1-sided or 2-sided tests. - Assess your stock portfolio risk and compare it to market averages - Calculate stock pair correlations

records.name: AZBrand
records.tagline: Cloud VPS, zero-egress S3 storage & AI website builder
records.description: AZBrand is an all-in-one cloud platform built for founders, developers, and agencies. Key features: • High-Performance Cloud VPS: NVMe Gen4 instances across 11 global datacenters with root SSH. • S3 Object Storage: 100% S3-compatible with $0 egress download fees & API keys. • No-Code AI Website Builder: Visual canvas powered by Gemini AI with custom domain support. • Business Telecom: Local VoIP lines ($4.99/mo) and SIP trunks. • Edge Security: Always-on Layer 3/4/7 DDoS mitigation & WAF.

records.name: GravixChat
records.tagline: AI chatbot trained on your website and documents
records.description: GravixChat lets businesses build an AI chatbot trained on their own website, documents and knowledge. Automatically crawl your website, upload files, create custom instructions and workflows, support multiple languages and customize the chat widget to match your brand.

records.name: agentinfra
records.tagline: AI agent tools ranked by what they paid. Clicks are public.
records.description: A pay-to-rank leaderboard scoped to one category: AI agents and infrastructure. Rank is total paid, $5 minimum, and a raise costs only the difference. Free listings are welcome and rank below the paid ones by clicks. What's different: click counts are public on every listing, and the counting method is published on /rules. So you can watch exactly what a rank delivers before deciding it's worth paying for. Every other board in this wave asks you to bid blind.

records.name: AI Front Desk
records.tagline: Every Call Answered. Every Opportunity Captured.
records.description: AI Front Desk is an intelligent, AI-powered virtual receptionist that helps businesses manage calls and customer interactions 24/7. It answers questions, captures leads, schedules appointments, routes calls, and automates routine front-desk tasks. By reducing missed calls and response times, it improves customer experience, increases efficiency, and allows businesses to focus on growth while maintaining reliable communication.

records.name: ClaudePet
records.tagline: A floating desktop pet that reacts to Claude Code
records.description: ClaudePet is a native macOS companion that lives in a floating panel and reacts in real time to your Claude Code sessions — idle, working, waiting on permission, ready for review, or failed. Built entirely on Claude Code's hooks (no first-party API exists). Track streaks, XP, and per-project spend, jump between sessions with a command palette, and use custom Codex-format pet skins. Everything runs locally — nothing is ever uploaded.

records.name: MoonTube - Youtube Automation Suite
records.tagline: AI finds what your audience is BEGGING you to make next
records.description: MoonTube scans YouTube comments to find exactly what viewers want next — frustrations, requests, confusion points. Then AI generates viral-ready titles, hooks, and script outlines from those pain points. Like having a research team that works 24/7 inside your browser.

records.name: NapCat
records.tagline: Your AI agents. Right in the notch.
records.description: NapCat turns your MacBook notch into a live control center for Claude Code and Codex. See when agents are working, waiting for input, or finished; jump back to the exact session; handle supported Claude prompts; and keep long-running tasks awake behind a private nap screen. Your coding activity stays local on your Mac. Try it free for 2 days, then pay $7.99 once.

records.name: CopilotResume
records.tagline: Your resume, your data — AI resume builder done right
records.description: Most resume tools track you, paywall your download, and quietly feed your career history into someone else's model. This one doesn't. • theMirror — see your resume exactly as a recruiter and an ATS read it, with specific fixes, not a vague score • ATS Check + JobFit — score yourself against the real job ad before you send it • Fair View —strip your name, age and gendered wording so your skills get the interview • Live Resume — one link that's always current and easy to hand a friend for feedback

records.name: ERD Online
records.tagline: Git + Figma for database design, with MCP for AI agents
records.description: Open-source ERD tool with versioning, real-time collaboration, and MCP integration. Let Cursor, Claude, and Cline read/write your schema. Try the live demo in 30 seconds — no signup required.

records.name: devdigest.io
records.tagline: One daily AI tech digest, and why it picked each story
records.description: You've got a dozen tabs open labeled "read later" and none of them get read. devdigest.io picks the best tech and AI stories from 110+ sources daily, tailored to your topics, in one email. Every story carries a one-line reason it's there: topic match, a source you've upvoted, or editorial ranking, so it's never a black box. Downvote something and say why, and it reweights what you see next. Solo-built, no ads, no data-selling. Free 14-day trial, no card required, €50/year after.

records.name: Vertex SEO Agency
records.tagline: Helping Businesses Rank Higher & Grow Online
records.description: Vertex SEO Agency is a Sheffield-based SEO and digital marketing agency helping businesses improve rankings, increase visibility, and generate more leads. We provide Local SEO, Technical SEO, Content Optimization, SEO Audits, and data-driven strategies for sustainable online growth.

records.name: K1VPN
records.tagline: Privacy-first VPN with Bitcoin and Lightning payments
records.description: K1VPN is a privacy-focused VPN service supporting WireGuard, IKEv2, OpenVPN and VLESS across servers in more than 45 countries. It follows a no-logs policy, supports P2P traffic and allows up to 10 devices. Customers can pay by card, Bitcoin or Lightning through a self-hosted BTCPay Server. Crypto users can create a randomly generated account without providing an email address. A 48-hour free trial is available.

records.name: Chesspoly
records.tagline: Chess with an economy: earn coins, build your army
records.description: Chesspoly is a strategy game where every match starts with a lone king and 3 coins. Move non-king pieces to earn coins, spend them to build your army, and find checkmate. Play online, against the computer, or together.

records.name: CRS Visa
records.tagline: immigrate to Australia
records.description: CRS Visa is a professional Canada and Australia immigration consultancy helping individuals explore opportunities to work, live, and settle abroad. We provide guidance for Canada PR, Canada work visas, Australia work visas, PR pathways, eligibility assessment, and documentation support. Our team focuses on clear communication and practical guidance to help you understand your immigration options and make informed decisions throughout your visa journey.

records.name: Beauty cosme
records.tagline: “Luxury in Every Gift, Joy in Every Moment.”
records.description: ✨ Luxury in Every Gift, Joy in Every Moment ✨ Make every special moment unforgettable with a touch of luxury. 🎁💎 From premium beauty essentials to elegant shopping favorites, the perfect gift is just a moment away. Treat yourself, surprise someone special, and turn every gift into a beautiful memory. ✨

records.name: Tools Network
records.tagline: Every tool you need. No signup. No tracking. Just results.
records.description: Stop bookmarking a dozen different sites for your daily tasks. Tools Network is a comprehensive, fast, and easy-to-use suite of online utilities right in your browser. From SMTP Server Test Tool to Base64 Encoder & Decoder, get things done without downloading an app.

records.name: Appliage
records.tagline: A free appliance age finder using serial numbers
records.description: Appliage turns a serial number into an appliance’s manufacture date. It helps when paperwork is gone, a repair decision depends on age, or a reused year code points to several decades. The result page shows Confirmed, Estimated, or Candidates, explains the code, links its evidence, and flags CPSC recalls. Add the model only when needed to narrow repeating years. Records come from manufacturers, CPSC, DOE, ENERGY STAR, AHRI, California, and NRCan. 79 brands. Free, no signup.
